name: Actor continues shopping from the cart
scenarioId: classpath:features/cart:Actor continues shopping from the cart
methodName: Actor continues shopping from the cart

testSteps.description: Given Actor is on the home page
When Actor adds "Combination Pliers" to the cart
And Actor is on the cart page
Then Actor should be on the home page

userStory.narrative:
As a customer,
  I want to manage products in my shopping cart
  So that I can review and adjust my order before checkout

title: Actor continues shopping from the cart

rule.name: Customer should be able to navigate away from the cart
